newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: CRICKET-PRIME MINISTER'S XI BEAT WEST INDIES BY 58 RUNS. [CORRECTED 08:39 GMT]
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-PRIME MINISTER'S XI BEAT WEST INDIES BY 58 RUNS. [CORRECTED 08:39 GMT]

text.p: An Australian Prime Minister's XI beat West Indies by 58 runs in a limited overs tour match at Manuka Oval on Tuesday.
Scores - Prime Minister's XI 258 for eight in 50 overs (Ian Harvey 55 not out); West Indies 200 for nine in 43.4 overs. (Corrects from 44.4 overs)
West Indies number 11 Patterson Thompson did not bat.
